card.fact_statement: 2024 YR4 was discovered by the Asteroid Terrestrial-impact Last Alert System.
card.source_span: The asteroid was discovered by the Chilean station of the Asteroid Terrestrial-impact Last Alert System (ATLAS) at Río Hurtado on 27 December 2024.

card.fact_statement: 2025 GN1 was discovered by the Dark Energy Camera.
card.source_span: 2025 GN1 is an Atira-type near-Earth asteroid discovered by the Dark Energy Camera (DECam)
